name: MWWA Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Announced in the fed's own founding FAQ and put up for grabs in a sixteen-man single-elimination tournament whose format DDT unveiled on 20 August 1997, running toward the promotion's own first Supercard, Windy City Showdown, 20 September 1997; no reign is recorded within this collection's own held record, which ends before the bracket completes.

name: MWWA Television Title
epitaph: Announced in the fed's own founding FAQ; the four Title Tournament entrants eliminated short of the semifinal are diverted into a separate four-man tournament for this belt. No reign is recorded within this collection's own held record.

name: MWWA Tag Team Titles
epitaph: Announced in the fed's own founding FAQ; the community's own on-air commentary names Team Canada, the Ministry of Justice and Heavy Metal as contenders. No reign or tournament format is recorded within this collection's own held record.
